newsitem.title: New zealand: NZ's Peters to host radio talk-back show on Sunday.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Peters to host radio talk-back show on Sunday.

text.p: New Zealand First leader Winston Peters will host a four-hour talkback session on Radio Pacific on Sunday, the New Zealand Press Association reported on Friday.

The station's permanent week-day morning host is former cabinet minister John Banks, who was involved in a confrontation with Peters in a lobby outside Parliament's debating chamber on Wednesday night.
Radio Pacific's executive chairman Derek Lowe said on Friday Banks often talked about Peters on his morning show "so we think it's only fair that Winston gets a chance to talk back".

Asked whether he thought Banks might call Peters, Lowe said he thought that after 15 hours of talkback a week Banks would probably have had enough, "but on the other hand he often says get out of bed Winston, I know you're listening', and he's an unpredictable fellow and this is radio so anything's possible".
Banks announced before the selection of the current cabinet that he was not seeking a ministerial position and was taking up the talkback host's role.
